text:
alex: Quick question — are we still mixing 429 vs 503 for quota vs capacity? Should per-tenant burst be 503 or 429? Need consistent client UX + console mapping.

maria: i'd vote 429 = client/quota, 503 = infra/backpressure. 429 -> retryable with `Retry-After` when appropriate. 503 implies broader service degradation. :+1:

kevin: Console wants a single Failure Reason bucket. Can we expose a unified label in telemetry like `failure_reason` (quota|capacity|internal|fallback) and map phrases in the UI? Makes alerts + dashboards simpler.

liz: agree. For client headers i propose we standardize on a small set so SDKs can act predictably. e.g.:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
X-Redwood-Failure: quota
X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining: 0
```
and for graceful fallback responses:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Redwood-Fallback: true
X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason: capacity
X-Redwood-Fallback-Model: redwood-small-v1
```

jun: telemetry naming note: prefer labels instead of metric proliferation. e.g. `inference.requests.total{outcome="fail", reason="quota"}` and `inference.responses.degraded{fallback_model="redwood-small-v1"}`. That keeps dashboards composable.

alex: what about soft fallbacks where we still return 200 but content quality lower? Clients won't notice unless we signal it. we should add an explicit header + SDK flag so apps can surface a warning.

maria: yep — header + telemetry. `X-Redwood-Fallback: true` + `X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason: capacity` and in telemetry count as `degraded_response`. SDKs can surface a subtle banner or metric.

kevin: rollout UX ask: when canarying fallback models, console should show: % traffic on fallback, degraded-response rate, and a simple toggle to rollback. need `rollout_id` and `rollout_variant` in telemetry so widgets can join events.

ops-bot: deploy: canary rollout started -> id=canary-20240321-42, pct=5% (1748500000)

sam: +1 to headers + telemetry. also add retry guidance in responses so clients don't hammer when fallback active.

liz: also standardize user-facing message copy returned by SDKs: one short actionable sentence + link. e.g. \"Request blocked: quota exceeded. See https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#quota\" so translations and console copy are consistent.

jun: i'll draft a micro-RFC with proposed header names, metric names and example dashboard queries. anyone want to review? @maria?

maria: happy to review today :mag:

alex: great — plan: land header + metric names in codebase this sprint, then add console widgets for fallback visibility next sprint. thanks everyone.
